episodes.title: Chapter One
episodes.summary: In 1920s Korea, Yangjin and Hoonie shield their only child, Sunja, from the realities of life under colonial rule. In 1989, Solomon closes a big deal.

episodes.title: Chapter Two
episodes.summary: Hansu opens Sunja's eyes to the world, but it inspires dreams that come at a price. Solomon attempts to leverage his Korean identity.

episodes.title: Chapter Three
episodes.summary: Sunja discovers surprising new details about Hansu. Solomon looks to his grandmother for help.

episodes.title: Chapter Four
episodes.summary: Newlywed Sunja embarks on an epic journey that takes her far from the comforts of home. Solomon gets ready for his big day.

episodes.title: Chapter Five
episodes.summary: As she arrives in Japan with her husband, Sunja must depend on the help of others. Solomon copes with the aftermath of his deal.

episodes.title: Chapter Six
episodes.summary: Sunja goes into premature labor while Isak grapples with a political awakening. Solomon finds Hana, his long-lost love.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven
episodes.summary: As a young man in 1923 Yokohama, Hansu is thrown into a cataclysmic disaster that will change everything.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight
episodes.summary: Sunja learns that Isak has been arrested and searches for him with the aid of her young son. Solomon makes a fateful decision.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine
episodes.summary: World War II forces Sunja to make dangerous decisions for her family's survival. Pushed to the edge, Solomon takes a stand.

episodes.title: Chapter Ten
episodes.summary: The family reunites with a loved one and confronts a harsh reality. Solomon makes a discovery that could prove beneficial.

episodes.title: Chapter Eleven
episodes.summary: Sunja and the children flee Osaka only to find their new location has its own challenges. Solomon's past leads him to new beginnings.

episodes.title: Chapter Twelve
episodes.summary: As new relationships blossom, a tragedy threatens to destroy everything. Sunja meets a close friend of Solomon's.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirteen
episodes.summary: The family's fight for survival begins anew as WWII reaches the home front. A surprise figure thwarts Solomon's perfect plan.

episodes.title: Chapter Fourteen
episodes.summary: Five years after the war has ended, Hansu is at the top of the criminal underworld—but his riches come at a great price.

episodes.title: Chapter Fifteen
episodes.summary: Mr. Kim faces a difficult choice: the woman he loves or his homeland. Both Solomon and Mozasu execute ruthless plans.

episodes.title: Chapter Sixteen
episodes.summary: Season finale. Noa uncovers a devastating truth. Solomon learns of an old enemy's fate. Sunja must decide between her past and her future.
